title: Antes del Amor
overview: In a quiet neighborhood, two neighboring houses are home to couples facing their own struggles and routines, where everyday life hides tensions, secrets, and small conflicts. When an extraordinary woman and a daring neighbor develop an intense and unexpected attraction, they are drawn into unfamiliar territory, challenging the boundaries of loyalty, desire, and commitment. The story explores the complexities of relationships, showing how emotions can collide with responsibilities, fears, and social expectations. The central conflict lies not only between the characters themselves, but also in the internal and external obstacles that keep them apart, creating a drama filled with emotional tension and moments of vulnerability.
